source_sample: DE - Fisher Scientific Products Current/Future Price.xlsx and UK - Fisher Scientific Products Current/Future Price.xlsx
description: Fisher Scientific DE/UK reseller price file (xlsx, 23 columns). Currency and price source depend on the customer's region (raw EUR list string or raw GBP uk_clp) and price period; per-pharma Fisher cost/price column pairs follow the layout. DE and UK customers exclude their region's SKU list.
price_columns: Fisher supported purchase (cost) price for Sanofi

columns.expression: (lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_uk_clp.csv', 'uk_clp_future' if customer.get('price_period') == 'future' else 'uk_clp') if customer.get('price_currency_field') == 'gbp' else lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_dkfz_bmecat_fields.csv', 'eu_future_list_price' if customer.get('price_period') == 'future' else 'eu_list_price') if customer.get('price_currency_field') == 'eur' else '') or price_for_rounded(row, 'list_price_' + customer.get('price_currency_field', 'usd'), customer, 0)
